conversation.message: How have you been feeling lately, overall?
I guess I have been feeling pretty tired lately. I wake up in the middle of the night and can't go back to sleep.
How long has it been since you've felt rested after waking up?
Months, maybe? It feels like I've been running on empty for a long time.
Is it harder to focus or concentrate than it used to be?
Yeah. I get distracted easily. I'll be in a meeting and suddenly I'm thinking about something else.
How often does that happen during meetings?
It happens a lot, to be honest. I try to stay engaged, but my mind starts to wander.
How have you been sleeping lately?
Not well. I wake up a lot, and I usually don't fall back asleep until morning.
How many times would you say you're waking up in a typical night?
Maybe five or six times? I don't know, it feels like a lot.
Been doing anything you enjoy lately?
Not really. I used to like hiking, but I haven't done that in a while. I just don't have the energy for it lately.
How long has it felt like you've been without that energy for things you used to enjoy?
I guess a year? Maybe longer. It just feels like I'm stuck in neutral lately.
When you think about the next few weeks, what do you expect day to day?
I don't know. It feels like I'm just going through the motions. I guess I'll just keep showing up and trying to get through each day.
What does "just going through the motions" look like for you on a typical day?
I just sit there. I look at the screen, but I don't really see anything. I'm just waiting for the day to be over.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than before, even small ones?
Yeah. I find myself second-guessing everything. I used to be more decisive, but now I just get stuck.
How long does that feeling of being stuck usually last?
Hours, maybe. Sometimes days. I guess I just freeze up until I have to do something.
Do you feel like you have enough energy for your usual day?
No. I feel like I'm running on empty by lunchtime.
What's the first thing you notice when that "running on empty" feeling hits?
I get a headache. It starts behind my eyes and spreads to the rest of my head.
Are you still into the things you used to care about?
I guess not as much. It all just feels different lately.
What feels the most different to you?
Everything. The way I think, the way I feel. It's all changed, but I'm not really sure why.
Is there anything weighing on your mind that you wish you could change?
Yeah. There are a lot of things I wish I could go back and do differently.
Can you tell me about one of those things you'd do differently?
I guess I would talk to my sister more. We used to be close, but we haven't spoken in a while.
How do you feel about how things have gone for you recently?
I don't know. I guess I'm just stuck.
What feels like it's keeping you stuck?
I don't know. I just feel lost, I guess.
How's your appetite been?
Bad. I haven't been eating much lately.
How long has it been since your appetite changed?
Months, maybe? I just don't have the energy to cook or eat much.
Have you found yourself getting emotional more easily lately?
Yeah. I get overwhelmed by small things. I just cry sometimes because I don't know what else to do.
